summary: Applies compressor, limiter, pre, and post dynamics processing to audio channels for gain control, limiting, and musical dynamics shaping.
key_concepts: Audio Dynamics CHOP applies pre gain, compression, limiting, and post dry/wet processing to audio channels.
The compressor can use automatic gain control or other compression behavior depending on Compression Type.
A second side-chain input can determine the gain changes applied to the first input channels.
Compressor and limiter channel-linking settings decide whether channels are processed together or independently.
Specific Info CHOP channels expose compressor and limiter gain reduction, dB values, and timing diagnostics.

key_params.name: compressiontype
key_params.note: Compression behavior such as automatic gain control or musical dynamics

key_params.name: drywet
key_params.note: Blend processed dynamics output with the input

common_gotchas: Channel linking changes stereo/surround image behavior; equal processing preserves balance while independent processing can shift it.
Compression and limiting can alter audio-reactive envelopes, not just audible loudness.
Dynamics processors depend on input level; normalize or meter before expecting stable behavior.
Use limiter carefully as a safety stage before Audio Device Out, not as a substitute for gain staging.
